title: MODELING SUBJECTIVITY (BY MIMICKING ANNOTATOR ANNOTATION) IN TOXIC COMMENT IDENTIFICATION ACROSS DIVERSE COMMUNITIES

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating inter-rater reliability (IRR) and cross-replication reliability (xRR) across different individual annotators, expert pools, and demographic subgroups, followed by using soft prompt tuning to train an LLM to mimic individual annotators' subjective viewpoints on toxicity.
Comparing the subjective perception of toxicity and computing disagreement metrics (IRR, xRR) between an African American annotator pool and a general control annotator pool.
